title: Concrete additive local sections of the resolved presheaf
statement: Let C,R and both derived universes satisfy [def-per-local-rhom-normalization-interface]. For a complex L, a derived object K and isomorphism k:QL to K, the explicit resolved presheaf P_L^n of [lem-per-local-rhom-presheaf-model] has an additive equivalence at every M,U with morphisms res_U K to res_U(M[n]). It is obtained by the fixed localization factorization, exact evaluation of module presheaves, the additive local comparison into a K-injective resolution, and transport by the localization and representative isomorphisms.

source.place: Tags 0A8Y, 0A94, 0A95; sites-modules.tex Tag 03EI; derived.tex Tags 0147 and 0149

proof.text: Apply the presheaf localization factorization on QX, evaluate at U, and use exact evaluation of module presheaves to identify its cohomology with the homology of the section complex. Apply the additive canonical derived comparison into the fixed K-injective resolution of X. Transport along resQ for L and the target restriction-shift isomorphism, followed by the inverse of the localized augmentation X to I(X). For arbitrary M, take the specified Q.objPreimage M and transport along Q.objObjPreimageIso M. Transport the source by k using additive homCongr. Naturality on complex representatives combines the evaluation homology naturality, the component-characterized local comparison naturality, and the augmentation square. All component formulas use the fixed localization factorizations.
